headline: SITCON eases to 4 (GUARDED); OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 and SonicWall SSL-VPN KEV flaw remain the top stories

bullets.text: SITCON drops from 3 (ELEVATED) to 4 (GUARDED) with no new reports since the 02:21 SITREP: only 1 exploited vulnerability was added to CISA KEV in 72 hours. The last 7 days scored 0.72x the 90-day average. Still developing: OpenSSH, SonicWall, Zyxel GS1900 and exposed GitHub secrets.

OpenSSH, 5 outlets: CVE-2026-123158 was exploited in the wild hours after disclosure. Related: OpenSSH's emergency fix for a flaw letting long passwords bypass SSH auth on Alpine Linux, which also reaches routers.

SonicWall, 3 outlets: SonicWall patched an exploited SonicOS SSL-VPN flaw that weakens VPN logins (CVE-2026-19868, single-factor authentication). CISA added it to KEV on 2026-11-06, federal due date 2026-11-20.

Zyxel GS1900, 3 outlets: the vendor fix did not block the in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441) used to hack nearly 1,000 switches, allowing root command execution. D-Link separately warned of multiple zero-days in DGS-3130 Series switches.

Exposed secrets, GitHub and Artex stories across 4 outlets: hackers are using Artex to scan GitHub repositories for exposed secrets; Microsoft reports threat actors using agentic AI tooling to find and abuse them; Truffle Security launched a program to revoke nearly 1.5 million live secrets.

Breaches: a $133 million French bank heist via a service provider; Chainalysis says credentials for all customers were exposed; DigiCert and DreamHost also reported breaches; Norad was targeted. Top ransomware leak sites, 7 days: n0n (49), qilin (25), soul (25), the gentlemen (25).

actions: Patch OpenSSH on every internet-facing host for CVE-2026-123158; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for exploitation.
SonicWall SSL-VPN users: apply SonicWall's patch for CVE-2026-19868 now (KEV due 2026-11-20) and review VPN logs for logins that skipped MFA.
Treat Zyxel GS1900 and D-Link DGS-3130 switches as exposed: restrict management access, check for compromise, apply fixes as they ship.
Scan GitHub repos and their history for committed secrets; revoke and rotate anything found and enable secret scanning with push protection.
Chainalysis, DigiCert and DreamHost customers: reset passwords, rotate API keys and credentials, and watch for phishing.
Patch Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (KEV due 11-13) and Apple CVE-2024-27834 (due 11-18); WordPress CVE-2026-119977 is past due.
